name: Compressor Motor Overload Trip
description: Primary mechanical compressor motor electrical trip on I-90. Power draw dropped to 0W. Cargo temperature rising at +1.4°C/hr.

name: R-404A Refrigerant High-Pressure Line Leak
description: Refrigerant line fractured from vibration. System lost cooling charge. Rapid thermal rise at +1.8°C/hr.

name: Rear Door Gasket Micro-Seal Infiltration
description: Door seal gasket torn on rough highway section. Hot ambient air entering cargo chamber at +2.1°C/hr.

name: Evaporator Fan Ice-Up & Core Choke
description: Moisture condensation caused ice buildup on evaporator fans. Airflow blocked; hot spots developing at +1.6°C/hr.

name: Auxiliary Battery Power Unit Cell Dropout
description: Secondary lithium battery bank dropped below 11.2V. Reefer operating on reserve power with 18 minutes of runtime remaining.

name: Condenser Fan Debris Impact Damage
description: Highway debris shattered external condenser fan blades. Thermal cutoff engaged to prevent motor fire.

name: Emergency Dry-Ice Depletion Runaway
description: Backup dry-ice bunker depleted to under 8% remaining mass due to elevated ambient road temperatures.

name: Reefer Inverter High-Temperature Lockout
description: Power inverter module reached 88°C internal junction limit, triggering automatic safety thermal protection shutdown.

name: I-90 Interstate Hazmat Fire Standstill
description: Complete highway standstill 30 miles south of Madison. Delay projected at +150 minutes, jeopardizing the 06:00 AM surgical delivery.

name: Liquid Nitrogen Pressure Relief Valve Lock
description: Cryogenic dewar valve stuck open, venting nitrogen reserve. Vaporization rate doubled; secondary barrier active.

name: Telematics Microcontroller Thermal Brownout
description: Primary sensor hub suffered voltage irregularity. Secondary sensor reports rapid thermal climb to 6.5°C.

name: Extreme 41°C Ambient Asphalt Heatwave
description: Asphalt radiation heatwave pushing external wall temp past 48°C. Active refrigeration duty cycle at 100% capacity.

name: Cargo Bay Access Sensor Tamper Trigger
description: Electronic tamper latch triggered on highway. Temperature spiked from open airflow, requiring immediate GxP quarantine inspection.

name: Diesel Alternator Drive Belt Slippage
description: Alternator belt glazed and slipping under load. Generator output dropped 75%, disabling auxiliary cooling compressor.

name: Microprocessor Defrost Cycle Runaway
description: Reefer defrost heater coil stuck in continuous active heating cycle, actively injecting thermal energy into the cargo hold.

name: Multi-Axis Severe Pothole G-Shock Excursion
description: Severe 4.2G shock on interstate expansion joint dislodged dry-ice retention bracket, causing rapid thermal venting.
